# Reduced fixture shape snapshot

`manifest.json` contains only the fields consumed by the CPU shape tests:
all 3,204 tensor names, shapes and dtypes, and the converted key count.
It is projected from the reduced fixture generated by
`tools/deepseek_v41/fixtures.py` using pinned DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash revision
`df42c109f1defefcbfcedbe7d905718a12266e40`. One tensor per line keeps the
snapshot reviewable without requiring CUDA fixture generation in CPU CI.

This static snapshot is not a runtime fixture manifest. The generator still
writes the complete manifest beside the safetensors payloads, including tensor
and file hashes, config, ownership, input sequences and reference provenance.
`validate_fixture.py`, `oracle.py` and `validate_oracle.py` consume that generated
directory; their byte and provenance checks are unchanged.
